description:
Reviews, one at a time.

Follow the Letterboxd members whose writing you love, then swipe up through their film reviews as full-screen reels: one per page, nothing else on screen.

A FEED WITH AN END
Each session holds 20 reviews (or 10, 30 or 50, your choice), then stops on a "Fin" card. Keep reading if you want to, but on purpose. Come back later and a new session is waiting.

THE WORDS FIRST
• Only written reviews. No lists, no likes, no comments.
• Set like a magazine page: poster, title, year, rating, then the text with its italics, quotes and links.
• Hide the stars and likes to read the words before the verdict.
• Reviews with spoilers stay covered until you tap.
• Long reviews open in a full reader.

READ BEFORE YOU FOLLOW
Search for anyone on Letterboxd by username or profile link, and read their reviews as reels before you follow them. Not sure where to start? VILLE suggests critics, writers, filmmakers and creators who review often: tap a name to read them first.

KEEP THE ONES YOU LOVE
Bookmark a review to keep it on your iPhone, even if you stop following its author. Bookmarks work as a watchlist too: swipe one away once you've seen the film. A review with spoilers stays covered there until you're ready.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
VILLE comes in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese and Chinese. When a review is written in another language, one tap translates it, right on your iPhone. Long-press the text to copy a passage.

PICKED WITH CARE
New reviews come first, newest first, then the ones you read longest ago. Members take turns, so no one fills your feed, and VILLE avoids showing the same member or film twice in a row. In Settings, choose to see each review only once, or hide very short ones. Pull the first reel down to check for new reviews.

THE FILM AROUND THE WORDS
Each film comes with its poster, or with alternative posters from other countries' releases: tap one to flip it. Tap a title to look the film up. Turn on backdrops for a different image behind the words each time a film appears. Prefer pure text? Turn the posters off. Light, dark or system appearance.

YOURS, ON YOUR IPHONE
No account. No ads. No tracking. The people you follow and the reviews you bookmark stay on your iPhone, and the reviews you've read stay saved even after they leave a member's feed.

CREDIT WHERE IT'S DUE
Every review shows its author and links back to the original on Letterboxd. Sharing sends that link, never the text. Tap an author's name to open their profile, report the review on Letterboxd or unfollow.

VILLE reads the public RSS feeds of the Letterboxd members you follow or search for. Reviews belong to their authors. VILLE is not affiliated with or endorsed by Letterboxd. Film images come from TMDB: this product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
promotionalText: Follow the people whose film writing you love on Letterboxd and read their reviews as full-screen reels. One at a time, and with an end.
